strings.appearance.drag_a_panel_s_header_to_an_e: Drag a panel's header to an edge of the window or onto another panel to move it. Double-click the space between two areas to collapse it.
strings.appearance.tick_to_show_drag_or_use_the_: Tick to show, drag or use the arrows to reorder.

strings.login.connect_your_spotify_premium_accou: Connect your Spotify Premium account to get started.
strings.login.client_id_of_your_spotify_applicat: Client ID of your Spotify application
strings.login.create_an_application_on_the_spoti: Create an application on the Spotify developer dashboard (Web API + Web Playback SDK), add the redirect URI below, then paste its Client ID above.
strings.pages.sonora_plays_your_local_audio_file: Sonora plays your local audio files (MP3, FLAC, AAC/M4A, WAV, OGG, Opus, WMA) and your Spotify account. Add a music folder to get started.
strings.pages.tip_search_accepts_spotify_s: Tip: search accepts Spotify's operators — artist:, album:, track:, year:2020-2024, genre:, label:, isrc:.
strings.pages.no_genre_in_your_files_metadata: No genre in your files' metadata.
strings.pages.connect_your_spotify_account_to_fi: Connect your Spotify account to fill these pages.
strings.pages.all_the_discover_sections_are_turn: All the Discover sections are turned off in the settings.
strings.pages.counted_by_sonora_on_this_machine: Counted by Sonora on this machine, from your actual listening. Spotify does not give these figures to any third-party app.
strings.pages.themes_colors_type_panel_layout_an: Themes, colors, type, panel layout and displayed content
strings.pages.what_sonora_shows_turning_a_sectio: What Sonora shows. Turning a section off removes it from Discover, the home page and search.
strings.pages.send_your_listens_to_listenbrainz_: Send your listens to ListenBrainz, the open listening-history service — something Spotify allows no third-party app to do. As long as this field is empty, nothing leaves this machine.
strings.pages.click_a_shortcut_then_press_the: Click a shortcut, then press the combination you want. A combination already in use is taken away from its previous action. Alt+← / Alt+→ (navigation) and the keyboard's media keys cannot be changed.
strings.pages.check_for_updates_when_sonora_open: Check for updates when Sonora opens
strings.pages.the_check_contacts_github_github_c: The check contacts GitHub (github.com) and sends it nothing beyond what any web request contains. Nothing is ever installed without your click.
strings.pages.sonora_a_native_music_player_net_1: Sonora — a native music player (.NET 10 / WPF). Local files through Windows Media Foundation; Spotify through the official Web API and the Web Playback SDK. Sonora is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by Spotify.
strings.lyrics.lyrics_not_available_for_this_tra: Lyrics not available for this track
strings.sleep.at_track_end: Stops at the end of the track
strings.style.liquid.description: Very clear, domed glass with bright reflections and capsule shapes. Optionally, the current cover as the window background.
strings.style.terminal.description: Terminal look: monospaced font, square frames, dense lines.
strings.style.affiche.description: A concert poster: flat blocks of color, giant extended type, rows that invert on hover.
strings.style.soul.description: A 70s record sleeve: soft, bold serif, leaf-shaped corners, earth and sun colors.
strings.style.fonction.description: A spec sheet: office grey, fine rules, strict grid, a single orange touch for what is playing.
strings.style.encre.description: Ink-blue frame, white cards, condensed upper-case headings, pills.
strings.style.standard.description: Plain panels and rounded cards, understated.
